description:
What project you will be working on

As a C/C++ Developer at PSS - Prosoft Solutions, you will contribute to international projects, designing, developing, and implementing software solutions for the retail industry.

Currently, major projects include a new product release designed to enable retailers to fundamentally transform the way they interact with their customers.This cutting-edge, unified, cloud-based commerce platform addresses key areas in the retail sector, including POS (Point of Sale), mobile devices, self-service, promotions and customer loyalty, payments, analytics, big data, and more.

We are involved in long-term international projects, uzing Agile development methodologies.

Profile we are looking for: 

As part of our team, you will bring relevant experience in software development using C/C++, strong integration skills to adapt seamlessly, and the ability to collaborate effectively within an international team.

If you check the requirements below, apply for a place in our team:

  • ·        at least 3 years of C/C++ programming experience;
  • ·        knowledge of using relational databases (SQL);
  • ·        experience using versioning systems (SVN, Git);
  • ·        advanced level English;
  • ·        ability to solve problems in a timely manner.

An advantage would be:

  • ·        Linux programming knowledge;
  • ·        .Net programming knowledge;
  • ·        network programming knowledge;
  • ·        Bat/Python scripting knowledge;
  • ·        knowledge of Java and JEE technologies;
  • ·        C/C++, Java, SQL certifications

Why join our team:

We support and encourage our team members in acquiring new skills and competencies and also focus on the growth of each team member, ensuring that everyone reaches their potential. We value professionalism, accountability and commitment to growth through constant learning, developing new skills and assimilating new knowledge.

So, if you want to work on international projects, in a professional and friendly environment, with the opportunity to create a career plan and develop it through flexible programs and other benefits in line with the company's performance standards, we encourage you to apply for this position.
